notes.TWN: 台灣：主計總處國民所得統計（支出面，當期價格），商品及服務輸出加輸入除以 GDP，自行計算。
notes.SDN: 2021 年起只剩 2–4%（2019 年 26%、2020 年 10%），跟 2021 年匯率改革前後的本國貨幣換算有關，世界銀行的原始值明顯偏低，僅供參考。
notes.HKG: 香港、新加坡超過 300% 是轉口貿易：進口後再出口的貨物進出各算一次，不代表經濟「依賴」貿易的程度。
notes.SGP: 香港、新加坡超過 300% 是轉口貿易：進口後再出口的貨物進出各算一次，不代表經濟「依賴」貿易的程度。

notesEn.TWN: Taiwan: computed from DGBAS national accounts (expenditure approach, current prices) as exports plus imports of goods and services divided by GDP.
notesEn.SDN: From 2021 the ratio drops to 2–4% (26% in 2019, 10% in 2020), apparently a currency-conversion artefact around the 2021 exchange-rate reform; the World Bank figure is clearly too low.
notesEn.HKG: Hong Kong and Singapore exceed 300% because of re-exports: goods imported and shipped on are counted on both sides.
notesEn.SGP: Hong Kong and Singapore exceed 300% because of re-exports: goods imported and shipped on are counted on both sides.
